user.title: Connect ABL Wallbox
user.description: Connect an EVCC2/3 controller using a transparent TCP bridge or a serial device. TCP requires host and port; leave the serial device empty. The RS485 side must use 38400 baud, 8E1. Release the connection in other applications. Setup only reads data; it does not change charging settings.

error.cannot_connect: No valid controller reply. Check the address, connection and physical serial settings.
error.bridge_busy: Another program occupies the bridge. Disconnect the ABL PC software, COM redirector and other integrations.
error.invalid_connection: Enter a hostname without http:// or a serial device path.
